evals.name: auth-telemetry-changelog
evals.prompt: Сгенерируй API changelog для ветки 001-auth-v2-telemetry — там были изменения в контроллерах авторизации и DTO. Хочу понять, есть ли breaking changes перед мержем.
evals.expected_output: Structured Keep a Changelog entry in docs/api-changelog/ with proper categorization of auth controller and DTO changes, breaking change detection, and migration notes if applicable

evals.name: auth-sprint1-small-changelog
evals.prompt: Generate API changelog for the changes in branch 001-auth-v2-sprint1 compared to main. Only 2 files changed so it should be quick.
evals.expected_output: Concise changelog for a small diff — should still follow the full format but with fewer entries. Should correctly identify that it's a small change set.

evals.name: notifications-large-changelog
evals.prompt: Нужен полный API changelog для ветки 001-notifications-v2 — это большая фича с кучей новых контроллеров и DTO. Особенно важно найти все breaking changes, потому что у нас мобильные клиенты на старой версии API.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive changelog with many entries across Added/Changed/Removed/Breaking sections. Should handle 73 changed files gracefully, possibly suggesting to narrow scope. Migration notes for all breaking changes.
